Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> Theatre ‘3 Shots For Baby Jesus’ brings Accra nightlife to theatre this Christmas 21 November 2026 9:07am ▶ Listen to this article Audio By Carbonatix
Audiences at 3 Shots For Baby Jesus , the new Christmas play by Ghanaian filmmaker and playwright Joewackle J. Kusi, will spend the evening as customers of a struggling bar in Accra, ordering drinks and performing with the band while its staff try to rescue their kidnapped MC from a loan shark.
The immersive production, from Church of Stories in partnership with Africa Arts Network, opens on Christmas Day at Accra Art District in Osu and plays again on 26th December, before returning on 9th and 10th January 2027. There are two performances each night, at 7pm and 9pm.
The play takes place in a real bar, staged as its regulars’ favourite spot for a night out in Accra, where the audience joins as extras gathered for a Christmas party. They can talk to the cast, order from the bar, take a turn with the band or settle in with a drink, all while watching the drama unfold around them.
The bar is struggling, and Christmas there feels anything but festive. However, its ambitious, mismatched staff are determined to change that at this year’s party. When the flamboyant MC is kidnapped halfway through the night, they must work together to rescue him from a notorious loan shark and ultimately save the bar from shutting down in the new year.
Joewackle, who wrote and directs the play, uses it to explore the Christmas experience in Accra since Ghana’s Year of Return campaign in 2019.
“I have always been fascinated by nightlife in Accra. For my second play, I knew I wanted to set the story in a space I was very familiar with, and at a time that resonates with everyone.
“Staging the play in a bar creates a different kind of intimacy between the audience, the space, and the performers. I want the audience to feel like they’ve known these characters all their lives, like they’ve spent most Saturday nights with them in this very bar.”
3 Shots For Baby Jesus is Joewackle’s second stage play. His first, There Is Rice At Home, earned critical review among theatre aficionados. The new play follows his six-part audio drama series The Gold Coast Darlings , also a Church of Stories production, and his short film Home, Or Our Journey Is Still Long .
